Sup. Ct. Tex. Motions of petitioners for leave to proceed informa pauperis denied. Petitioners are allowed until February 1,1999, within which to pay the docketing fee required by Rule 38(a) and to submit petitions in compliance with Rule 33.1 of the Rules of this Court.
